performance_limits: One cold/warm sample per view and viewport; no navigation percentile, sustained load or supported-device population claim. Desktop Chromium uses a mobile viewport, not mobile hardware.

Two-animation-frame timings are rendering-opportunity proxies, not physical paint or hardware keyboard latency. Scroll percentile is from requestAnimationFrame intervals during programmatic scrolling.

Current directory search submits explicitly. Recorded <=500ms is submit-to-result, not proof of the predeclared 150ms automatic-debounce behavior. Warm search uses a different query against a warm process.

One browser API request is not a chain/RPC range budget measurement. Synthetic unauthenticated data/cursors do not qualify canonical refresh, authenticated rebuild, real-proof latency, wallet funding or all RC40 criteria.
privacy_limits: Browser-side public-origin request window only; no paired server-ingress observation, response body inspection, trusted-query/upstream or other-origin coverage.

No match means no observed occurrence of the two configured account representations in captured URL/query/header strings; it is not a cryptographic unlinkability claim or exhaustive private-value leakage test.
